oil.when: 2008 without Driver Information Center buttons (trip odometer reset stem)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the vehicle in PARK and the ignition on, press the trip odometer reset stem until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows.
Press and hold the stem until OIL LIFE REMAINING reads 100%.
You should hear three chimes and the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message goes off.
If the message comes back when you next start the vehicle, repeat the steps.
Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the vehicle in PARK and the ignition on, use the DIC buttons to show OIL LIFE REMAINING.
Press and hold the set/reset button until 100% shows.
You should hear three chimes and the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message goes off.
If the message comes back when you next start the vehicle, repeat the steps.
